theater_mia_quest_01_03_02:
Well, that's Miach for ya... The tricky

motive at all~
theater_mia_quest_01_03_03: Yeah... I have no idea what to do anymore...
theater_mia_quest_01_03_04:

to hurt anyone—
theater_mia_quest_01_03_05:
Um... I think Miss Nahza's mood

theater_mia_quest_01_03_07:

If I play this right... me and Bell...
theater_mia_quest_01_03_09:

theater_mia_quest_01_03_10:
—"Lovesickness"?

theater_mia_quest_01_03_11:

theater_mia_quest_01_03_12:
What?! What do you mean, Hestia?!
Do you know something about this?!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_13:
Oh, for crying out loud! Seeing's believing!
I'll show you right now! Bell!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_15:
Of course! You want to clear up Miach's

Now! C'mere!!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_16: Y-you really... want to do this?
theater_mia_quest_01_03_17:
I just want to clear up his
misunderstanding, that's all! Not a single
impure thought in my head!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_19:
Ahh, yes! Tighter! Squeeeeeze!
Ohhhhh, Belluuuuu!!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_20:
Th-this is...! A flushed face, sweating...
and fever and rapid breathing!
The illness's symptoms...?!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_21:
Eheheheh~... See...? Those are...
the symptoms... right...?
theater_mia_quest_01_03_25:
—And there you have it.
Even with the symptoms, I'm the picture
of health, right?
theater_mia_quest_01_03_26:
Well... if anything, you're
abnormally glowing.
theater_mia_quest_01_03_27:
Right? Lovesickness is a source of energy!
There's nothing to worry about,
not one bit!
theater_mia_quest_01_03_28:
...I see. So there are
illnesses like that, too.
theater_mia_quest_01_03_29:
Mm. Living alongside an illness... If I
explore that, it might lead to a new
kind of potion.
theater_mia_quest_01_03_30:
I'll tell Nahza right away and study this
illness in depth. I'm in your debt,
both of you.
theater_mia_quest_01_03_32:
Yeah... Nahza might
blow up again...
theater_mia_quest_02_01_01:
Back when Bell first took Lili
on as his supporter—
theater_mia_quest_02_01_02: Lord Miach, this is for you...
theater_mia_quest_02_01_03:
Tea leaves...?
What's this, all of a sudden?
theater_mia_quest_02_01_04:

I've been earning well in the Dungeon

theater_mia_quest_02_01_05:
...I see. Then I'll gratefully accept.
Sorry to make you go to the trouble.
theater_mia_quest_02_01_06:
Oh, no, it wasn't expensive or anything.
Please enjoy it with everyone.
theater_mia_quest_02_01_07:
...So that's what happened. Nahza and I

theater_mia_quest_02_01_08: No fair, no fair, NO FAAAAIR!!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_10:
A present from Bell?! I can count on one
hand how many big events like that
I've had!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_11:
No fair—no, I'm JEALOUS!!
Why Miach and not meeeee?!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_12:
I can only say it's because I've been
giving Bell potions...
theater_mia_quest_02_01_13:
That's it!! If I give Bell
a potion too...!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_14:
A potion from the goddess...! Ahh, it's

theater_mia_quest_02_01_15:
Goddess, I can't hold back anymore!
Let me thank you... passionately...!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_17:
Hmm... Quite the fantasy for
a virgin goddess.
theater_mia_quest_02_01_18:
Who cares about that?! I'll give Bell
a potion too and score myself a present!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_20:
So, Miach! Teach me how to make

theater_mia_quest_02_01_21: All right, I've got all the ingredients!
theater_mia_quest_02_01_22:
Aqua Serpent liver,
Crystal Turtle blood—
theater_mia_quest_02_01_23:
And... Hellhound testicles?
What exactly are you trying to make...?
theater_mia_quest_02_01_25:
None of these are ingredients we've ever

theater_mia_quest_02_01_26:
Never mind the details!

theater_mia_quest_02_02_02: Hestia, that's not medicine. It's poison.
theater_mia_quest_02_02_04: A miracle, as if you'd used Arcanum...
theater_mia_quest_02_02_05:
...Done! How about that, Miach?

theater_mia_quest_02_02_07: Aw, c-come on, don't praise me so much...
theater_mia_quest_02_02_08:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_10:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_12:
Ugh... I'm out of ingredients...
Operation: Get a Present from Bell in

theater_mia_quest_02_02_14:
Don't just brush off the tragedy

theater_mia_quest_02_02_15:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_18:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_23:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_24:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_26:

theater_mia_quest_02_02_28:

I thought it might give me some ideas

theater_mia_quest_02_02_31: That's fine. I'm the one who decides that.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_01:
...If I had to put it into words,

theater_mia_quest_02_03_03: Yes. As a goddess, I think you'll understand...
theater_mia_quest_02_03_04:

theater_mia_quest_02_03_05:

Bell's given me so much, too.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_06:

theater_mia_quest_02_03_08:
I'm a god of medicine. I want to ease the

theater_mia_quest_02_03_09:
Thanks to the children who give us such

theater_mia_quest_02_03_12:
Didn't you just come up with that?
To fit my situation.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_13:
Heh. Gods really are troublesome.
To see through me so easily.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_14:
Of course I can tell. A god who acts that
logically wouldn't dive into the mortal
world out of curiosity.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_15:
You've got all sorts of stronger feelings

right?
theater_mia_quest_02_03_16:
Yes, perhaps.
But... I believe there's more than a little
truth in it.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_17:
Maybe... you're right. I take it back.
Can we say it's what you "felt" just now,

theater_mia_quest_02_03_19:
But somehow... I feel like I get why
you hand out medicine. What you feel.
theater_mia_quest_02_03_21:
I'm gonna think about it too.
Bell gives me so much excitement
and joy...
theater_mia_quest_02_03_22: So what kind of thanks can I give back?
theater_mia_quest_02_03_23:
Yes. That's best. It may be a roundabout

theater_mia_quest_02_03_24:
All riiight! Launching Operation: Thank
Bell and Get a Present in Return,
take two!!
theater_tak_quest_01_01_01:
Step right up, step right up!
Fresh fish on sale today!
theater_tak_quest_01_01_03:

theater_tak_quest_01_01_04:

theater_tak_quest_01_01_06:

theater_tak_quest_01_01_07:

Why the long face?
theater_tak_quest_01_01_09: ...Let me guess. You're strapped for cash?
theater_tak_quest_01_01_11:
Then I've got just the thing for you.
How about it? Want in?
theater_tak_quest_01_01_13:

...Yep, I think you'd be perfect.
What do you say?
theater_tak_quest_01_01_14:

theater_tak_quest_01_01_15:
It's shift work, so you should only

theater_tak_quest_01_01_19:
Wh-wh-WHAT?! That much?!

theater_tak_quest_01_01_20:

theater_tak_quest_01_01_21:
...All right.

something good.
theater_tak_quest_01_01_22:
Yep. Forget fish—you'll be popping
champagne at fancy restaurants.
theater_tak_quest_01_01_25:
......
Are you sure this is the right place?

theater_tak_quest_01_01_27:
Hmm... This kind of atmosphere isn't

I can do?
theater_tak_quest_01_01_28: I'm getting a bad feeling about this...
theater_tak_quest_01_01_29:

now that we're here.
theater_tak_quest_01_02_01:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_02:
They're looking for a good new host,

theater_tak_quest_01_02_03:
N-no, no, no, no!
There's no way I could do that...!
theater_tak_quest_01_02_04:
Sorry, Hermes, but forget what

theater_tak_quest_01_02_05:

something delicious.
theater_tak_quest_01_02_07:
A whole sashimi boat plus all-you-can-drink

theater_tak_quest_01_02_09:
Besides, Takemikazuchi...

theater_tak_quest_01_02_11:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_12:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_13:
But it piles up and wears them down. This

theater_tak_quest_01_02_14: It doesn't seem so noble to me...

theater_tak_quest_01_02_18:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_19:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_20:
You look troubled.
Did something happen?
theater_tak_quest_01_02_21:
L-Lord Takemikazuchi?!
What are you doing in a place like this?!
theater_tak_quest_01_02_22:
Oh, I was asked to help out. I thought

theater_tak_quest_01_02_23:
I saw you looking so troubled, and I

theater_tak_quest_01_02_24:
You'll listen to me?
Well, actually...
theater_tak_quest_01_02_25:
Ah, Lord Takemikazuchi...

theater_tak_quest_01_02_26:
I see. I'm glad. A gloomy face

theater_tak_quest_01_02_27:
Lord Takemikazuchi...

theater_tak_quest_01_02_28:

theater_tak_quest_01_02_30:
That "natural-born ladykiller" title isn't

theater_tak_quest_01_03_01:
Um...! I'd like to talk

theater_tak_quest_01_03_10:

theater_tak_quest_01_03_11:

theater_tak_quest_01_03_22:

For the first time, Takemikazuchi

theater_tak_quest_01_03_25:

theater_tak_quest_01_03_28:
Lord Takemikazuchi...
what are you doing...?
theater_tak_quest_01_03_29:

theater_tak_quest_01_03_32:
Adios... Greatest host in Orario's
history...
